privacy_body:
No tracking cookies and no third-party analytics are used.

We keep aggregated, anonymous visit stats: IP addresses are not stored, and the visitor id is a hash whose salt changes daily, so visits cannot be linked across days.

Messages sent through the contact form are stored only to reply to you.
